title: SIGPIPE on large DIFF can cause pipefail to misreport pipeline exit status, potentially skipping review
bug_summary: Under `set -euo pipefail`, when `grep -qE` exits early (found match) before `echo "${DIFF}"` finishes writing, echo receives EPIPE and exits 141.

title: Per-file chunked-cache uses sha256sum (not available on macOS), effectively disabling cache
bug_summary: The chunked-review per-file cache key is computed with `sha256sum`, which is not present in macOS by default (only `shasum -a 256` is).

title: No trap cleanup for DIFF_TMPFILE in codebase mode
bug_summary: If the script is killed (SIGTERM/SIGKILL/timeout), the temp file created by mktemp leaks in /tmp.

title: Single-match regex allows `git worktree list | git worktree add` to bypass block
bug_summary: The `[[ "${cmd}" =~ ${worktree_re} ]]` check finds the *first* match in the command string.

title: `GH_ISSUE_FILING_DISABLED` guard fires after dedup check, so dedup marker is never written while the var is set
bug_summary: The order of guards in the filing section is: (1) arbiter FAIL check, (2) dedup check, (3) `GH_ISSUE_FILING_DISABLED`, (4) `gh` availability.

title: `--mode=full-diff` and `--mode=codebase` silently rerouted to chunked review on large diffs
bug_summary: The progressive-review `elif [[ ${DIFF_LINES} -gt ${REVIEW_MAX_LINES} ]]` branch fires before the `--mode=full-diff`/`--mode=codebase` handlers at lines 566/656, and unconditionally calls `perform_chunked_review` then `exit $?`.

title: Markdown/lockfile/empty-diff short-circuit uses staged index even in full-diff and codebase modes
bug_summary: The empty-diff, markdown-only, and lockfile-only checks run unconditionally before the `--mode=full-diff` and `--mode=codebase` routing at lines 570/660, and they query `git diff --cached --name-only` rather than inspecting the DIFF read from stdin.

title: Newline-chained gh api .../merge bypasses api-merge guard after `^|` removal
bug_summary: The negation regex was narrowed from `(^|[;&|(`])[[:space:]]*gh[[:space:]]+` to `[;&|(`][[:space:]]*gh[[:space:]]+` to fix false positives in heredoc bodies (#131 / new test at scripts/tests/test-hook-block-api-merge.

title: `msg=$(grep -v '^#' ... | awk ...)` can trigger set -e under pipefail when commit message is empty/template-only
bug_summary: Script runs under `set -euo pipefail`.

title: update-tools.sh submodule check always succeeds
bug_summary: `git submodule status --quiet` returns 0 even when no submodules exist (it just produces no output).

title: EXIT trap cannot see _chunk_results when interrupted mid-function
bug_summary: The EXIT trap references `${_chunk_results:-}`, but that variable is declared `local` inside perform_chunked_review.

title: `%%` prefix extraction uses last-match position when the same literal appears multiple times
bug_summary: `prefix="${cmd%%"${match}"*}"` strips the longest suffix, giving everything before the *last* occurrence of `${match}` in the full command string.

title: Hard limit of 200 open issues may silently miss older duplicates
bug_summary: `gh issue list --limit 200` caps the listing.

title: `unworked` excludes retry-queued items on non-`capped` stops
bug_summary: When the loop halts on `diverging`, `no_progress`, or `queue_explosion`, `unworked` is set to `[]` even though `retryQueue` may contain items that were rejected by the verifier and re-queued for another attempt but never got one.

bug_summary: `pw="$(op read "${op_ref}" 2>&1)"` merges stderr into the captured value.

title: `url_encode` mishandles multi-byte UTF-8 characters
bug_summary: `${s:i:1}` extracts one character, but `printf "'${c}"` with a multi-byte UTF-8 char returns only the first byte's value.

title: `command -v realpath` returns empty string if realpath not installed; ln -sf creates dangling symlink, masking the real test failure
bug_summary: If `realpath` is not available in PATH on some CI runner, `command -v realpath` returns an empty string.

title: ssh wrapper - ((r > best)) && best= pattern may trip set -e on same-block multi-pattern hosts
bug_summary: The `((r > best)) && best="${r}"` idiom returns exit code 1 when the comparison is false, which under `set -euo pipefail` can cause unintended failures.

title: ssh wrapper - _fetch_op leaks temp file on SIGINT/SIGTERM between mktemp and rm
bug_summary: `mktemp` creates a temp file with no trap; a signal between creation and the `rm -f` leaks it.

title: EXIT trap inside function uses local variables that will be out of scope at script exit
bug_summary: The `trap 'rm -f "${fulldiff_log:-}" "${codebase_log:-}"' EXIT` is set inside `run_reviews()` using `local` variables.

title: Retries without timeout command provide no benefit against hangs

title: tsc-baseline-check.sh silently passes if `npx tsc` itself fails to start
bug_summary: If `npx tsc` cannot run (missing binary, broken node_modules, network failure on first npx fetch), the script captures error text that lacks "error TS" tokens, sets COUNT=0, and reports "current < baseline — bump baseline" — passing instead of failing.

title: Gradle wrapper timeout plugin silently no-ops if networkTimeout property is missing
bug_summary: The regex `/networkTimeout=\d+/` only replaces an existing `networkTimeout` line.

title: Escape-hatch grep pattern does not match documented format
bug_summary: The check uses `grep -qF '[skip-claude-review]'` (fixed string, literal brackets), but every user-facing doc instructs writing `[skip-claude-review: reason]` — which contains no substring `[skip-claude-review]` because the closing `]` sits after `: reason`.
